function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content: Hai! Untuk membantu cek ketersediaan ukuran 40, bisakah kamu beri tahu produk atau kategori apa yang kamu maksud? Misalnya “sepatu Nike Air Max” atau “kaos T-shirt” saja. Dengan begitu saya bisa cari stoknya lebih tepat. Terima kasih!
message.reasoning: The user says: "Size 40 kapan ready kak". This seems like a request in Indonesian: "Size 40 kapan ready kak" meaning "When will size 40 be ready, buddy?" They likely want to know when a product of size 40 will be ready. We need to search for products with size 40. But we don't have a function to filter by size. The function only allows keywords, category, price_range, sort_order, in_stock. We can search for "size 40" or maybe "40" as keyword. But we might need to ask clarifying question: what product? They didn't specify product. So we need to ask clarifying question: which product? Or we can search for "size 40" across all categories. But that might return many results. We could ask them to specify product or category. The user might be asking about a specific product they saw earlier. We should ask clarifying question: "Which product are you referring to?" Also we can ask if they want to see availability. So we should respond asking for clarification.
